# PhotoConfig

`jaff.core.reaction.config.PhotoConfig`

<!-- Generated by `python -m jaff._utils.api_docs`; do not edit. -->

Photo-reaction settings (`[network.reactions.photo]`).

`None` means unset: the value comes from the global settings.

## Attributes

| Attribute | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `pi_database` | `str or None` | Photoionisation cross-section database: `"norad"`, `"verner"` or `"leiden"`. |
| `override_custom_rate` | `bool or None` | Recompute a `.jfunc` `chemRate<N>` rate from the cross sections. |
| `override_custom_cross_section` | `bool or None` | Ignore `.jfunc` `photoCrossSection<N>` and use the database. |
| `use_proxy_photoreaction` | `bool or None` | Look cross sections up under the proxy reaction (`CHx` → `CH`). |
| `shielding` | `ShieldingConfig or None` | Line shielding of the rate; without it, the rate is not shielded. |
